scripts.release:auto: op plugin run -- gh workflow run 'Release' -r 7.x -f bump=auto -f post_to_slack=true -f source_sha="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
scripts.generate-api-trello: openapi-generator-cli generate -i docs/api/i2-trello.oas3.yml -g php -o Openapi --additional-properties='invokerPackage=MauticPlugin\\AivieTrelloBundle\\Openapi\\lib,bundleName=AivieTrello,phpLegacySupport=false,variableNamingConvention=camelCase' && npm run remove-not-needed-code && npm run format-all-code
